remarks: Welcome to Winnipauk Village, where comfort meets convenience. This beautifully updated 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath townhouse offers 1,220 sq ft of inviting living space. The main level features a bright, open-concept layout with a spacious living room anchored by a wood-burning fireplace (perfect for cozy evenings) and sliders leading to a private deck overlooking one of the community's sparkling in-ground pools. The newly renovated eat-in kitchen is a standout with stylish gray-blue cabinetry, quartz countertops, stunning tile, stainless steel appliances, and a charming window seat that makes mornings feel extra warm. An updated half bath on this level is perfect for guests. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms with ample closet space, a renovated full bath with double sinks, and the convenience of in-unit laundry. Every space has been thoughtfully maintained, offering a move-in-ready opportunity in one of Norwalk's most desirable condo communities. Set on beautifully landscaped grounds, Winnipauk Village offers a resort-like lifestyle with amenities including multiple pools, tennis/pickleball courts, a fitness center, and a clubhouse. Located in a peaceful residential setting near West Rocks, this home is just minutes from Route 7, I-95, the Merritt Parkway, Metro-North, Stew Leonard's, schools, shops, dining, and Norwalk's growing business district. A rare opportunity for comfort, style, and amenities in a prime location.
